body:
## What happened

Observed in the self-hosting instance (pdca-pdca), bundle `results/issue_506/`. The human ran the
interactive sign-off session, decided `iterate-do`, and the leaf wrote `signoff-decision` — the
token plus a multi-paragraph rationale. Every `pdca flow 506` pass after that printed the same
three lines:

```
flow: issue_506 — applying the 'iterate-do' sign-off decision already recorded in the bundle; no new session
flow: issue_506 — applying the recorded sign-off decision failed (PatternError: bad escape \W at position 743); skipping this bundle (left AWAITING_SIGNOFF)
flow: issue_506 — not auto-iterating: a 'iterate-do' sign-off decision is already recorded in the bundle, waiting to be applied
```

twenty times, then `pass budget exhausted after 20 pass(es)`. §9 was never written, `signoff-decision`
was never consumed, and the bundle could not leave `AWAITING_SIGNOFF` by any route.

## Root cause

`signoff.record` → `set_field` (`template/src/pdca_harness/signoff.py:180-185`) builds the `re.subn`
replacement as a **template string**:

```python
def set_field(body: str, label: str, value: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    pat = re.compile(rf"^(- {re.escape(label)}:).*?$", re.MULTILINE)
    repl = rf"\g<1> {value}" if value else r"\g<1>"
    new, n = pat.subn(repl, body, count=1)
```

`re.sub` parses backslash escapes inside a replacement template. But `value` here is human prose that
nothing sanitises:

* `Iteration delta` ← `flow._apply_decision`'s `rationale` (`flow.py:182`), the sign-off session's
  free text, flattened;
* `By / date` ← `f"{by} / {date}"`, where `by` comes from `--by` / `[project].author`.

Issue #506's rationale quotes the regex the bundle is about:

> Too broad: `_ERROR_LEAD_RE`'s `^\W*` lead plus a bare `error` word classifies substantive builder
> deaths as transient…

so `\W` reached the replacement template and `re` rejected it. Position 743 is exactly that `^\W*`.

The subject matter is incidental — **any** rationale containing `\W`, `\d`, `\1`, `\g<…>` and so on
does this, and quoting the offending code is the normal shape of a rejection rationale.

## Why this is a bug, not just bad input

Three weaknesses compound:

**1. The human's own prose is executed as a substitution template.** §9's entire purpose is to carry
the human's words verbatim into the bundle, and `driver._carry_forward_into_brief` then feeds them to
the next Do. Nothing sanitises the text, nothing documents the constraint, and the crash is not even
the worst case: a rationale containing a *valid* backreference does not error, it silently rewrites
itself.

```
>>> re.compile(r"^(- Outcome:).*?$", re.M).subn(r"\g<1> \g<1> literal", "- Outcome:\n", count=1)[0]
'- Outcome: - Outcome: literal\n'
```

The human wrote `\g<1>`; the bundle records the field label. Silent corruption of the carry-forward,
not just a failure to write it.

**2. The exception escapes every handler.** `re.PatternError` subclasses `Exception`, not
`ValueError`. `record`'s documented contract is "records or raises `ValueError`", and both callers
catch only that:

* `cli._signoff` (`cli.py:1387-1389`) — an uncaught traceback out of `pdca signoff <id> --iterate-do`;
* `flow._apply_decision` (`flow.py:184`) — falls through to `flow._isolate`, which reports it as a
  generic per-bundle error.

`_isolate`'s wording ("skipping this bundle") reads as something transient worth retrying. It is not.

**3. The failure repeats forever and has no exit.** `signoff-decision` is unlinked only *after* a
successful `record`. So the file stays on disk, `_apply_recorded_decision` re-reads it every pass
(read-before-asking, #453), fails identically, and `_maybe_auto_iterate` then correctly declines
because a decision is pending. The bundle burns the whole pass budget doing nothing.

None of the recovery paths work: re-running the sign-off session is not offered (the recorded
decision is consumed first, by design), `pdca signoff` tracebacks on the same line, and the
malformed-summary repair (`_repair_unsignable`) does not apply — `signoff.unrecordable()` returns
`""` here, because the SUMMARY is perfectly well formed. Only hand-editing §9 or deleting the
rationale clears it.

## What the fix should be

* **Substitute literally.** A callable replacement — `pat.subn(lambda m: f"{m.group(1)} {value}" if
  value else m.group(1), body, count=1)` — has its return value used verbatim, so no character in
  human text can be read as a template. That closes the crash and the silent `\g<1>` splice together.
* **Regression cover for all three exposed inputs**: a rationale quoting a regex, a rationale
  containing `\g<1>` (asserting it is *not* expanded), and a `by` value containing an escape.
* **Worth considering separately, not part of the minimal fix:** `_isolate`'s message implies a
  transient skip, and a decision that fails to record *deterministically* is retried every pass. The
  unsignable-SUMMARY path already has a quarantine-and-move-on answer (`_repair_unsignable`); a
  decision that can never be recorded has none.

## Evidence

* pdca-pdca `results/issue_506/` — `signoff-decision` (token `iterate-do`, rationale containing
  `^\W*`) still on disk, `SUMMARY.md` §9 still blank after 20 passes.
* Reproduction against the shipped line:

  ```
  >>> import re
  >>> re.compile(r"^(- Outcome:).*?$", re.M).subn(r"\g<1> the ^\W* lead", "- Outcome:\n", count=1)
  re.PatternError: bad escape \W at position 11
  ```

* `re.PatternError.__mro__` is `(PatternError, Exception, BaseException, object)` — confirmed not a
  `ValueError`, so the `except ValueError` at `cli.py:1389` and `flow.py:185` cannot see it.
* `git log -S` puts `repl = rf"\g<1> {value}"` in `3ca179a` (2026-06-04, "Initial PDCA quality-cycle
  harness"), unchanged since. Every generated instance carries it; it only fires when a human's
  rationale or `--by` contains a backslash escape, which is why it took until now to surface.
* pdca-pdca is carrying a local patch on its generated `src/pdca_harness/signoff.py` to unblock the
  bundle; it will be dropped in favour of this fix at the next `copier update`.
title: driver: a sign-off rationale containing a backslash escape cannot be recorded — the bundle strands at AWAITING_SIGNOFF with no exit
